prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one high-fidelity desktop web UI design comp, 1586x992 landscape. Reference image is visual-system authority ONLY: reproduce its 214px navy #193c61 navigation rail, 66px white topbar, Chinese Arial/PingFang typography, white surfaces on #f5f7fa, 1px #dde5ee separators, 5px controls/7px panels, #247965 primary actions. No gradients, shadows, hero artwork, KPI cards, fake revenue, notifications, commercial claims. Do NOT copy reference product table/content. New surface is merchant payment/logistics setup wizard. Sidebar title 直播商家工作台 with existing entries 商品, 库存, 直播工作区, 网站客服, Meta 消息, 平台支持, 设置; 设置 active. Topbar 演示店铺, 简体中文, 商家账号. Title 物流与收款设置. Small label 隔离演示 · 非正式收款. Four steps with step2 active: 1 选择平台, 2 连接账户, 3 配置方式, 4 检查状态. Center of task is PAYUNi 统一金流 own-account credential form with environment 沙盒测试 (selected) / 正式环境, merchant ID MerID (empty placeholder 请输入商店代号), HashKey and HashIV empty password inputs (no real/synthetic secret visible). Readable helper: 密钥仅加密保存，不会再次显示. Clear note: 保存账户不代表平台验证通过，也不会开启收款. One primary button 保存账户并继续, secondary 上一步. Safe supporting status summary: 平台 PAYUNi, 账户 待录入, 收款方式 未配置, 正式收款 未开放. Same content and polish for all variants. All text legible accurate Simplified Chinese, clean operate-mode layout, no browser window/device frame. Composition A: horizontal numbered stepper across top below heading. Under it one dominant broad white workbench, left 2/3 form with ample aligned fields, right 1/3 slim plain status/next-step text column separated by a rule. Form is the focal point, footer actions bottom right of workbench. Do not repeat status in cards. Show a compact bottom line 当前仅保存配置；真实收款需要独立验收.
scope: Merchant logistics and payments wizard composition only; not live provider acceptance
